videos.desc: A hand slides along the rim of a wooden picnic table until the fingers stop right where the top ends. At a lakeside camp two people pull a rope to the corner of a tarp, and a blue-haired person walks carefully out a narrow dock, pointing down, until their toes stop at the very end above the water.
videos.said: Got it. Whoa. All the way.

videos.desc: A woman in a workshop runs her hand over different flat tops: she sweeps dust off a wooden table, pours clear resin that sets into a glossy sheen, rolls a wooden wheel across a polished stone table, and finally admires a huge mirror-shiny factory floor.

A man in swim shorts stands at the edge of a garden pool holding a folded towel and smiling at the camera. In the pool a golden retriever puppy floats with its head and front paws resting through a bright pink inflatable ring. A grey pitbull drifts past in a red one, and the camera returns to the puppy dozing in the pink ring.
videos.said: Three, two, one. Lucas, Rocky, Gumbo.

videos.desc: In a coffee shop lined with shelves of brightly coloured cups, a red-haired woman in cat-eye glasses orders at the counter. A hand slides her a normal rainbow-striped mug of coffee and she lifts it and grins. Then a far bigger mug appears, and a bigger one still, until she is gripping a pastel-striped mug the size of a bucket with both hands, eyes wide and mouth open, its handle as thick as her wrist.

Two young men in yellow raincoats lean over the wooden rail of a small boat on a calm blue sea. A dark shape the length of the boat glides just under the surface beneath them. It blows a tall column of spray, then a barnacled humpback whale pushes its head and long ribbed throat up out of the water right beside the hull, rising higher than the men before sliding back down.

Extreme close-up of a woman squinting through a gold eye loupe at a minute brass cog held in a pair of tweezers right in front of her eye. She sits back at a workbench covered with tweezers, tins and springs, in a shop whose walls are hung with wall clocks, and holds the loupe up to her eye. Next she points a fine tool into the open case of a mantel clock, its brass wheels visible behind the glass. Then a tall grandfather clock with brass weights and a swinging pendulum fills the frame, and finally she stands with her arms out under the enormous brass gears of a tower clock.

A young man in a tie-dye shirt kneels on the floor of a big empty hall setting up coloured dominoes. The camera follows winding rainbow lines of standing dominoes across the floor, and a wide shot reveals they form one enormous spiral curling in on itself, with him crouched at the centre.

A hiker in a cap and backpack climbs down a red rock canyon trail; the camera looks along his boots as he steps from ledge to ledge, then opens onto huge layered sandstone cliffs and a thin stony path winding down into the gorge between the rock walls.

In a bright white photo studio a young woman spins around on a black office chair, laughing; two people beside her point and turn; the camera rises to show dozens of people turning and stepping on a large circular white platform ringed with potted plants, sofas and stools.

In a sunny back garden a wooden barrel rolls across the grass towards two onlookers; then a folding table with bats and balls appears, then a shopping trolley loaded with grocery bags; finally a very tall neat pile of wooden pallets stands on the lawn and topples into a scattered heap.

Four shots of long structures reaching out over a distance. A workman in a blue shirt holds a telescopic aluminium ladder that pulls out to full length in front of a wooden fence. A red fire engine in a city street has its aerial ladder run out high into the sky. A crane boom stretches diagonally across a hazy construction site at sunset. Last, two steel bridge arches reach out from opposite cliffs across a red rock canyon with a river far below.

In a busy gym, a very thin young man with red hair pulls up his vest sleeve and flexes his arm with a strained grimace — the arm stays narrow and bony. The clip cuts to a woman in a blue top who flexes a clearly rounded, defined bicep and smiles at the camera, and then to a huge bodybuilder in a black vest who raises both arms into a double biceps pose while two friends behind him shout him on.

A woman in a bright headscarf and a floral apron sits on a sunny terrace with a big patterned bowl of apples and potatoes on her lap. She turns a red apple against a small knife so that the skin comes away in one continuous ribbon rather than in pieces. The red and white ribbon gets longer and longer, curling over the edge of the bowl and hanging down past her knees towards the floor while she keeps turning the apple. She looks at the camera with her eyes and mouth wide open at how long the unbroken ribbon has become. Behind her are terracotta roof tiles, red geraniums in pots and washing on a line.

A young woman in a neon yellow crop top and shorts jogs towards the camera along a wide paved seafront promenade lined with palm trees, with a beach and blue sea on one side. At first a single black-and-white border collie runs beside her. As she keeps going, more dogs of different breeds and colours appear from both sides and fall in with her, until she is jogging in the middle of a small group of about six dogs, laughing and throwing her arms up.

In a sunny back garden, three people stand at a picnic table watching a striped beach ball get bigger and bigger until it fills the frame. A glass bowl of dough on the same table then rises until it bulges over the rim. Next a woman on the lawn watches a blue paddling pool grow out to its full size, and finally the whole group stands watching a yellow and blue bouncy castle rise up into a full castle with towers.

A man swims front crawl through bright turquoise sea that is so low and clear that the sandy bottom and his own shadow are visible right underneath him. Boats sit on the horizon and a dolphin leaps out of the water behind him. At the end he stops swimming and kneels beside a pale sandbank, the water reaching only to his chest.

A man at a bathroom basin screws up his face as he squeezes hard on an almost empty tube, getting barely a smear onto his brush. The film cuts to a young woman in a green towel headband at a bright counter with three blue toothbrushes laid out in front of her. She holds a full tube over each brush and squeezes out a thick coil of mint-green paste, winding it round and round into a fat spiral on every one, then looks up at the camera wide-eyed at the three big swirls.

On a country show field in golden afternoon light, a young woman in an olive tank top, tan work trousers, boots and work gloves kneels on the grass and pushes a huge orange pumpkin onto a wooden pallet next to a much smaller pumpkin. Then she stands up, steps back and smiles at it, surprised and proud. Older people stand behind a rope watching, next to a chalkboard with a list. A striped marquee, a table of smaller pumpkins and a wheelbarrow fill the background.

On a building site on a sunny day, a young woman in a white hard hat, safety glasses, a red checked shirt over a grey top and a tool belt stands on a ladder and holds a metal triangle ruler into the sharp point where two wooden roof beams meet, looking closely at it. A young man in a yellow vest holds up the beams from below and looks up. More wooden roof trusses rise behind them, and a woman stands on a balcony in the background.

In a harvested field at golden hour, a young man in a checked flannel shirt, white T-shirt, jeans, sunglasses and brown boots balances with his arms spread wide on top of a huge round hay bale lying on its side, a long cylinder of tightly rolled straw. He steps along it, wobbling and waving his arms. More bales stand in a row behind him, sheep run past, a black-and-white sheepdog trots alongside, and a farmer stands by a tractor and a gate with his hands on his head.

A frozen lake on a sunny winter day. A large flat round disk of ice has been cut out of the lake and floats in a ring of dark water. A man in an orange puffer jacket, a beanie and mirrored ski goggles pushes it with a long wooden pole so that it turns, then stands up straight holding the pole, while four friends sit on camping chairs on the disk, waving and cheering. An ice saw and a hand drill lie on the snow in front, and pine forest and snowy hills line the shore.

On building scaffolding high above a street, a hand holding a thin brush paints a small red dot on a huge white wall covered with neat rows of round dots in many colours. The view pulls back: a young man in a backwards cap, a white T-shirt, paint-spattered white overalls and a yellow harness steps back from the wall, squints and looks at his work. Little paint pots, brushes, a bucket and a coil of rope lie on the planks, and cyclists and people pass below.

At a market in an old stone town on a sunny day, a laughing young woman in a mustard jacket and wide jeans pushes against a heap of colourful wet sponges bursting out of a big wooden barrel. A blue elephant-shaped sponge on top grows bigger and bigger and pushes a wooden crate off, and huge yellow sponges swell up around the barrel. Small sponges lie on the wet cobbles. Shoppers and a dog stand among fruit stalls behind, and one man films the scene with his phone.

A red and yellow inflatable bouncy castle stands on the grass at a summer festival under a blue sky. Three young people in shorts jump on it at first, but the castle goes soft and sinks: its pointed red towers lean in and droop together, and the walls sag lower and lower until the three stand on a sunken floor. A young man in an orange T-shirt kneels in front of it beside the black air blower, its hose lying on the grass. Food trucks, white tents and people are in the background.

A beach at dusk under a purple and pink sky. A huge, perfectly round, shiny silver ball lies at the water's edge, reflecting the people and the sky like a mirror. A young woman in a green sweatshirt and white trousers touches it with both hands and smiles, a young man in a checked shirt pokes it with a long stick, a young woman in a cap crouches beside it, and two young men behind them look shocked, one holding his head. A wave washes in around the ball over seaweed and driftwood.

A bright modern hall with concrete walls, big windows, stairs and round hanging lamps. A tall clear box stands on the floor, almost full of white plastic balls. A young man in a blue T-shirt and cream trousers pours a stream of red balls into it from a metal bowl, so the red balls form only a thin layer on top of all the white ones. A laughing young woman in a burgundy top and dark skirt closes the lid, and he steps back with the empty bowl. A few red balls and cloth sacks lie on the floor.

An old-fashioned grocery shop with wooden shelves of glass jars, hanging hams and glowing wall lamps. On a white marble counter stands a brass balance scale: a small block of butter on paper sits on one pan and a single brass weight on the other, the two in balance. A raccoon in a white apron stands on the counter beside the scale, then leans across it and pulls the butter off the pan. A young woman in a burgundy top with a wicker basket watches, laughs and covers her mouth with her hand.

A modern office corridor runs beside a glass-walled meeting room whose lower part is packed with thousands of red, yellow, blue and green plastic balls. Balls cover the concrete floor. A laughing man in a straw hat, rust shirt and cream trousers rolls forward on a kick scooter through the balls, then throws his arms up and shouts with joy. At the end of the corridor a young woman in a lilac top laughs, covers her mouth and leans out from behind the glass to watch him.

A tiny attic bedroom with a round skylight, white beams and wooden floorboards, seen through the doorway. A giant inflatable pink flamingo fills almost the whole room from the bed up to the ceiling, its long neck bent under the roof beside a wicker lampshade. A laughing young woman in a mint top and white shorts is squashed against the wall beside it, one foot on the bed, pushing against the flamingo. An electric pump stands on the floor, and stacks of books and shelves are pushed to the edges.
